name: Moderna
outlook:
What Moderna says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue growthThe Company now expects total revenue growth of 15% to 25% in 2026, exceeding its previous outlook of up to 10% growth.
  • Full year 2026: cost of salesCost of sales for 2026 is expected to be approximately $1.7 billion, including the previously announced $0.9 billion non-recurring litigation settlement charge.
  • Full year 2026: research and development expensesResearch and development expenses for 2026 are expected to be approximately $2.7 billion, reduced from the Company's previous expectation of approximately $2.9 billion.
  • Full year 2026: selling, general and administrative expensesSelling, general and administrative expenses for 2026 are expected to be approximately $1.0 billion, unchanged from previous forecast.
  • Year-end 2026: cash and investmentsThe Company now expects year-end 2026 cash and investments of approximately $8.1 billion to $8.3 billion, increased from its previous outlook of $4.7 billion to $5.2 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 6, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
